description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rawathawatta, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520201
categorisation: This gazette exclusively deals with the amendment of a land title registration for a specific parcel of land (No.240 of Block 06) in the Colombo District. The content details the insertion of an owner's name, national identity card number, and ownership extent into the land registry, which falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" as defined for Type 4 (Land Gazettes). There is no mention of government personnel, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
